productionChain: Agent final authorization (top-level only; nested parentToolCallId remains foreground) -> BashInvocationAuthorization.consume -> ShellCwdBinding -> private one-use foreground launch

BackgroundShellTasks.createForegroundLaunch -> ForegroundTask.takeWait -> bounded SubagentScheduler -> createShellToolDefinition.executeForeground -> local bash/PowerShell exec -> Windows Job/POSIX group

stdout/stderr -> ShellInputObserver -> handleData -> OutputAccumulator -> stable throttled emitOutputUpdate -> ForegroundTask.publish -> Agent latest observer clone/freeze -> AgentSession -> InteractiveMode -> tool renderer -> bounded terminal frame queue

allocations.existing: OutputAccumulator decodes bounded <=64KiB windows (buffer views, decoder options, decoded strings); bounded tail trimming copies UTF-8 buffer/text. Existing <=50KiB foreground snapshots and delivered Agent clone/freeze remain. These allocations are measured, not claimed zero. Handoff clears onUpdate and cancels its one timer so later chunks no longer request foreground snapshots. No full accumulated output reconstruction or new tail copy.
lifecycleExemptions: BashInvocationAuthorization.consume: one-use launch, authority and transfer validation closures per eligible invocation

BackgroundShellTasks.createForegroundLaunch: one ForegroundTask/deferred/controller, one control/entry, stable execute closure, two settlement callbacks per invocation; uses existing task/reservation/history
BackgroundShellTasks.run: invocation-only combined signal/options array; existing scheduler closure, bounded result details/truncation copy and one terminal text assembly
createShellToolDefinition.execute/executeForeground: invocation-only delegation/release and stopUpdates closures; no new callback per delivery
BackgroundShellTasks.background: explicit command acceptance result; clears foreground callback and timer without output snapshot/copy
ForegroundTask.detach/finish: explicit ownership transition clears original signal/update/wait references
false-success-guard.observeToolResult: terminal/admission event only, recognizes running background fact on original foreground input; existing bounded obligation maps/hash

createLocalShellOperations.exec: one stable exit callback per invocation, registered for managed foreground and removed in finally; marks completing synchronously before inherited stdio drain. No allocation in this callback.

BackgroundShellTasks.canManageForeground: optional startup capability discovery, failing to legacy foreground when partial SDK controls cannot be queried; explicit background admission still uses strict assertAvailable.
allocations.bounds: Same limits: shell concurrency default16/hard64; active+queued default64/hard256; foreground map bounded by admitted tasks. Per shell 200KiB trim threshold, 64KiB decoding, 50KiB spill threshold, 5MiB spill cap. Retained text <=12000 chars per task, terminal notification <=8192 UTF-16 chars. Queued/running reservation and pending operation owned until cleanup; foreground map removes on handoff/settlement; close drains pending then clears.
allocations.terminalFrames: No terminal queue changes or new frame allocation. Existing one active/one pending frame and zero application full-frame copies preserved by unchanged downstream path; no new full TUI benchmark run.
allocations.objectPool: None; no profiler evidence or ownership need for one.

findings.fix: Only top-level final authorization can install foreground launch. Real Agent nested dispatcher regression confirms dependent step awaits actual shell completion and no handoff ID is offered.

Local shell exec registers a stable exit listener that marks completing before output drain and clears it in finally. Existing process observation test verifies still-pending drain and zero exit/error/spawn/close listeners after release.
Early handoff while prepareShellCwd awaits must keep onUpdate undefined during initialization. Regression produced three snapshots before fix, one terminal capture after fix.
Partial SDK hosts cannot always query active task controls. Optional eligibility discovery now returns false, preserving original foreground path; strict background admission unchanged.
